name: custom_window
title: 6-month window ending Mar 2026 (--window 6 --window-end 2026-03)
protects: Configurable windows: a 6-month window ending Mar 2026 on both bases (it contains Dec 2025, so adjusted differs from reported), the preceding 6-month window, n/a before 6 months exist, and no Apr-Jun 2026 data once the window end sets the as-of month.
